name: Detective Hodgins
source: Detective Hodgins is a detective in a separate district. He is a huge fan of Detective Steele and has been following The Doctor and The Copycat cases. However, he really doesn't want his district to be involved. He has a very rowdy personality and isn't exactly the friendliest man.
